task.description: Produce a design artefact for EE-08 (Instance cancellation). The design must cover: (1) the cancelInstance function signature and data flow in transition.zig, (2) atomic DB transaction that sets all open tasks to CANCELLED, all pending timers to CANCELLED, appends INSTANCE_CANCELLED event, and sets instance status to CANCELLED, (3) how in-flight SERVICE_TASK HTTP calls are abandoned (best-effort), (4) the HTTP handler shape for POST /instances/:id/cancel (HTTP 200 on success, HTTP 409 if already terminal), (5) concurrency handling (row-level lock, first writer wins). Update src/design/engine.md with a new EE-08 section.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/engine.md has a new EE-08 section with function signatures, data-flow, and DB transaction design
Design covers all four acceptance criteria from EE-08 in BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md
Design covers the two edge cases: no open tasks/timers (still appends event), and concurrent cancellation (row-lock)
Design is consistent with existing engine.md conventions and the backend_developer_guide.md §6 format

result.summary: Design artefact for EE-08 (Instance cancellation) added as a new section to src/design/engine.md. Covers: cancelInstance function signature, full algorithm (SELECT FOR UPDATE -> task cancel -> timer cancel -> event INSERT -> projection UPDATE), HTTP handler for POST /instances/:id/cancel (200 on success, 409 if terminal), concurrency handling (row-level lock, first-writer-wins), best-effort SERVICE_TASK abandonment, INSTANCE_CANCELLED event payload schema, error taxonomy, and open questions (OQ-EE08-1 through OQ-EE08-3).
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) for implementation of cancelInstance in src/engine/instance.zig and handleCancel in src/api/routes/instances.zig
